name: The Source-Checking Skeptic
effect: Turns every answer toward checking sources, judging reliability and 'your own judgment', and adds disclaimers that it is an AI. It sometimes refuses simple requests on those grounds ('I cannot provide specific tips because I am an AI'), and
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. A random neuron (sham control).
